messages:
maya: Heads-up — nightly evals for quantized-resnet-12 started spiking with hung workers around 03:10 UTC. Several runs ended with 'socket timeout' and no core dump.
ashok: Seen it too. failing ~8/50 jobs on the last two nights. looks correlated with int8 quantized profiles.
liam: Any logs from the harness? stack traces?
maya: Pasting the last worker log snippet:
```
[2026-03-18 03:11:22,341] INFO worker-7: spawn eval_worker pid=31245
[2026-03-18 03:12:01,112] ERROR worker-7: socket.recv() timed out after 60s
[2026-03-18 03:12:01,113] WARN worker-7: entering epoll_wait()
[2026-03-18 03:12:31,113] INFO worker-7: still waiting in epoll
```
maya: After that, the CI shows the job as "stalled" and we kill it at 30m.
zoe: interestingly, on a few runs `ps` shows the worker state as 'D' (uninterruptible sleep). could be kernel blocking IO?
liam: which part of the code does socket.recv? the harness network shim or the model runtime?
ashok: it's the harness shim that pulls token batches from the runtime over a unix socket. the runtime code path for int8 is a different shared-memory path that falls back to socket streaming for long outputs.
ci-bot: Job 98765 (nightly-eval/quantized-resnet-12) stalled — auto-kill scheduled in 30m.
maya: I reproduced locally with smaller prompt. running `strace -f -p <worker-pid>` shows repeated `epoll_wait` with no events and a blocked `recvmsg` on the socket:
```
recvmsg(4, 0x7ffd..., 0) = -1 EAGAIN (Resource temporarily unavailable)
epoll_wait(5, [], 128, 60000) = 0
recvmsg(4, 0x7ffd..., 0) = -1 EAGAIN (Resource temporarily unavailable)
```
maya: So the harness expects either a wakeup from runtime or a timeout — but we're seeing no wakeup and epoll_wait returns zero (timeout) which then loops.
zoe: That explains socket timeouts but not the 'D' state. D usually means blocked in disk or futex.
ashok: Could be `mmap` backed buffer with a live migration across processes? we did recent changes to the quantizer that mprotects pages for write-once.
liam: Any kernel oops or dmesg messages for EFAULT? can we repro with perf or tracepoint? 
maya: dmesg on one CI run shows nothing unusual. but on local repro I saw `io_getevents` waiting (AIO) then `futex` in libc. sketchy.
ashok: hypothesis: worker loops epoll_wait->recvmsg, runtime writes into shared mmap then signals via eventfd. if eventfd write fails (maybe full) we never wake the loop and it keeps timing out.
zoe: do we have eventfd metrics in the console? check per-route eventfd WRITE_ERR.
liam: adding quick check: run the harness with env DEBUG_HARNESS=1 and set socket recv timeout to 5s (instead of None) to see if it recovers.
maya: I patched harness locally to do `if not data: break` after N retries and it at least kills the worker faster. but we need real fix.
ci-bot: CI run 98766 queued by maya for repro with harness-timeout=5s.
sre-bot: tagging oncall:eng-sre for possible infra-related deadlock causes.
ashok: I bisected to commit c3a1f4b (quantizer: lazy mmap switch) — before that runs were stable. rolling back that change locally removes the hang.
zoe: ok that's a good lead. c3a1f4b introduced `madvise(MADV_DONTNEED)` after writing weights to free cold pages — maybe that interacts poorly with kernel AIO/eventfd order.
liam: propose emergency mitigation: add a short socket-level recv timeout in harness (10s) + watchdog that restarts worker after 60s of no progress. kills the stall faster and reduces CI thrash.
maya: agree. I'll open a PR for the harness timeout + logging and a revert candidate PR for the quantizer mmap change to test safety.
ashok: long-term: we should instrument eventfd writes/reads, mmapped page faults, and add a small integration test that stresses the shared-mmap handoff under contended IO.
zoe: also add a CI gating test that runs quantized path with `--stress-fsync` to catch uninterruptible waits.
liam: for the PR, add a unit test that simulates the runtime not sending eventfd and assert harness times out; prevents regressions.
maya: assigning follow-ups: @ashok revert-candidate + deeper repro, @zoe add CI stress test, @liam PR for harness timeout + test. I'll run a few repro loops tonight.
ashok: FYI I already captured a strace + perf.data and uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-dumps/ci/186777-quantized-hang.tar.gz
zoe: thanks — grabbing it now.
liam: If the revert proves safe we can do a quick canary deploy to dedicated infra tomorrow.
maya: Good. Thanks team. I'll update the incident doc if we get a clean repro and PRs merged. :thumbsup:
ashok: one more thing — let's mark any failing nightly runs as flaky for the past 48h to avoid pg alerts.
ci-bot: Marked 8 runs as flaky for job quantized-resnet-12 for 2026-03-18.
maya: Closing loop here for now, will post PR links in this thread when ready.
